vinh-t-ngo.text: Requested the Jan. 21, 2026 special-meeting item to consider a data center moratorium and require an EIR for any data center: "It provides an opportunity for the City Council to discuss environmental review requirements and next steps."

source.title: Special City Council Mtg. Scheduled for Jan. 21 to Consider Data Center Moratorium & EIR Requirement - City of Monterey Park

vinh-t-ngo.text: The council unanimously adopted a 45-day data center moratorium on Jan. 21, 2026, "brought forward at the request of Council Member Vinh Ngo."

source.title: Monterey Park City Council Directs Staff to Explore Options for Permanent Data Center Ban - City of Monterey Park

vinh-t-ngo.text: Sits on the Monterey Park council, which per the city voted unanimously on July 2, 2025 to intervene in the federal suit challenging warrantless immigration arrests (Perdomo v. Noem).

source.title: City of Monterey Park Statement on Federal Court Order in Vasquez Perdomo v. Mullin

vinh-t-ngo.text: Per his opponent's campaign site, Ngo attended a March 29, 2026 launch event to endorse Measure NDC, the citywide data center ban.

vinh-t-ngo.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party.
